fields.description: Fahid Beach Terraces brings six residential towers to the shoreline of Fahid Island. Apartments, duplexes and penthouses are paired with beach access, landscaped podium spaces and a clubhouse focused on everyday fitness and relaxation. It is a separate development from Fahid Beach Residences and The Beach House.

overview: The brochure includes building-level layouts as well as individual homes. Use both when comparing a home’s orientation, neighbours and relationship to shared spaces. Its curved balconies and varied plans make a unit-specific drawing more useful than a single project-wide size range.
research.locationNote: The developer describes direct connections to the beach, promenade and Coral Drive. Confirm the selected tower’s entrance and access arrangements; proximity is not a guarantee of a view or a particular service being included.
research.priceNote: The original price sheet starts at AED 3.6m, also reported by Property Finder. The portal marks the project sold out. A current home requires its own dated price and availability confirmation.
research.paymentNote: The table below reproduces the original standard schedule for Towers 1 and 2. Dates differ for Towers 3–6. Earlier instalments are historical; a new reservation or resale requires a fresh payment statement.
research.handoverNote: Aldar’s FY2025 pipeline lists completion in 2029. Property Finder gives December 2029. The year is the developer reference; the selected tower’s contractual delivery conditions govern.
